title: Triple 3-input positive-AND gates

sources.document: TI SN54LS11/SN54S11/SN74LS11/SN74S11 datasheet SDLS131 (April 1985, revised March 1988)

functions.text: 1Y is high only when 1A, 1B and 1C are all high.
2Y is high only when 2A, 2B and 2C are all high.
3Y is high only when 3A, 3B and 3C are all high.

electrical.notes: SN74LS11 figures (page 3). SN74S11: IOL 20 mA, IOH -1 mA (page 4).

timing.conditions: VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF
VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 2 kohm, CL 15 pF

notes: Timing is the SN74LS11 table (page 3). SN74S11 (page 4, RL 280 ohm, CL 15 pF): tPLH 4.5/7 ns, tPHL 5/7.5 ns typ/max. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS11 and 74S11 too.
